summary: start now says up front that a missing executable means a 2-7 min cold build (run it in the background) and names scripts/dev seed and the prebuilt-binary route.
remaining: preflight still starts a second cold build in the dev profile when only another profile is built, and `scripts/dev worktree` cannot seed from a never-built donor checkout

summary: 3D aimed fields (ADR 2026-10-13-aimed-fields-and-the-rule-s-subject-prop): a `fields` entry with `toward` + `speed` (an expression) pulls loose props along their own line to a prop, object or point that a rule re-aims with `aim`; the server, `sim` and offline re2 apply it alike. Velvet Orchestra's 45 generated impulse rules are one field and its gravity points at the stone itself.
remaining: 2D has no runtime gravity (phantom-harvest: body.gravity is fixed per prefab) and neither dimension has a rope/distance joint; the 3D pull is horizontal only (no pull up toward a raised target), has no distance falloff and does not act on players

summary: 3D rules name the prop that fired them `self` (prop_enter/exit/below, pickup/drop/prop_hit) and filter with `prop: [ids]`, so one rule serves every prop (Velvet Orchestra's 20 per-thing slot rules are 6, with no per-thing `_gone` vars).
remaining: no prop_x/prop_z built-ins and no for_each for rules that are not fired by a prop (a timer over every tile still needs one rule per tile); 2D (brittle-lantern beds) unchanged; per-entity variables and timers are the separate `no-per-entity-timers` gap

summary: `pickup`, `drop` and `prop_hit` now carry the prop they are about: a rule names it `self` and `"prop": id` beside the event filters on it (a swing at the radio can be the dial).
remaining: rules still cannot read held inputs, the aimed-at object, the player's velocity or loudness, and carrying a prop still blocks the bat swing

summary: random(a, b), floor, round, abs, sqrt, min and max exist in the shared expression language since #99 (ADR 2026-10-10-story-is-rules-and-tables-not-a-story-system), play2d/re2d pick a new seed per launch; `describe rules` lists them since #115 (they were never listed, which is why runs kept reporting them missing).
remaining: a 3D match always uses the same seed: RulesEngine::reseed exists and nothing calls it, so 3D random draws repeat from launch to launch

summary: 2D games have string tables, `pick`, `wrap` and a dialogue widget since #99 (ADR 2026-10-10-story-is-rules-and-tables-not-a-story-system).
remaining: 3D scenes have no tables or `pick` (ADR 2026-10-13-the-next-phase, phase 2 item 4)

summary: scripts/daily_improve.py lands each night's work as a pull request that merges itself once every hosted check passes (settled the next day if CI is slow); a failed one stays open for a maintainer and is closed after three days, never stranded on a branch
the daily improver checks the two oldest open keys against main every run and records fixes.json entries for what is already fixed
remaining: the 132 keys open on 2026-10-20 close two a night unless someone triages them sooner; nothing yet checks that a fix commit records its key
